prompt: This repo is an order-processing package (`shop/`, nine modules) and README.md is its specification. Customers report wrong totals, wrong stock levels and odd invoices. Find and fix EVERY place where the code in shop/ disagrees with README.md (there are several, spread over different modules), and add a regression test for each fix in tests/ (run with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`). Keep the existing tests passing and do not rename or change the signature of any public function or class.
